prompts.name: Defense prompts
prompts.hint: When an attack on targeted tokens succeeds, post a defense card (Dodge, Parry, Block, No defense) to each target's owners and the GM.

autoDamage.name: Open Apply Damage after a hit
autoDamage.hint: After 'Roll damage' on a defense card, open the Apply Damage dialog on the target, prefilled with the rolled damage, hit location and number of hits (on the GM's screen when only GMs may open it).

maneuverPrompt.name: Maneuver prompt at turn start
maneuverPrompt.hint: When a combatant's turn starts, last turn's maneuver ends (it lasts until your next turn, B364): reset it to Do Nothing and ask the owner (the GM for NPCs) to pick one, unless they already picked one for this turn.

stunRecovery.name: Stun recovery roll
stunRecovery.hint: Offer the stunned combatant's recovery roll (HT, or IQ for mental stun, B420). By the book the roll comes at the end of each of the stunned character's turns.
stunRecovery.end: At the end of the stunned character's turn (B420)
stunRecovery.start: At the start of the stunned character's turn

toggle.retreatHint: +3 Dodge, +1 Block/Parry, +3 Parry with a fencing weapon (B377). Not while stunned.
toggle.dodgeAndDropHint: +3 to Dodge a ranged attack; you end up prone (B377).
toggle.acrobaticHint: Roll Acrobatics first: +2 to Dodge on a success, -2 on a failure (B375).

note.noParryRanged: Ranged attacks can't be parried, except thrown weapons (B376).
note.noBlockFirearm: Bullets and beams can't be blocked (B375).
note.noParryManeuver: Move and Attack: dodge or block only (B365).
note.doubleDefense: All-Out Defense (Double): try a different defense (B366).
note.deceptive: Deceptive Attack: -{penalty} to defend (added for you, B369).

reason.cantSee: Can't see the ranged attack: no active defense (B390).

turn.recovered: {attribute} roll made by {margin}: no longer stunned.

warn.noDefender: The defending token or actor can't be found.
warn.noAttacker: The attacking token or actor can't be found.
warn.noGMForDamage: Only GMs may open Apply Damage and no GM is online: drag the damage from the chat message onto the target.

info.damageSentToGM: Damage sent to the GM to apply.
